title: Industrial IoT Motor Control Center v9 (Fixed)
name: Industrial IoT Motor Control Center v9 (Fixed)

configuration.description: v8: fixed main gauges by removing duplicate units and min/max clutter; manual fan control changed to slider. Trend charts are unchanged.

settings.cardHtml:
INDUSTRIAL IoT MOTOR CONTROL CENTER
Edge processing • MQTT • ThingsBoard • bidirectional control • overload and cooling-failure protection
70°C Edge Cooling 85°C Alert Mode 95°C Hard Trip Normal upload: 5s avg Alert upload: 1s

CONTROL PANEL GUIDE
Emergency Stop: stops motor and forces max fan.
Reset System: clears emergency/hard trip and restarts safe mode.
Manual Mode: disables automatic fan control.
Manual Fan RPM: use the stepper to change fan speed by 100 RPM.
Fault Injection: overload and fan failure are for lab testing.

settings.title: MANUAL MODE
settings.parseValueFunction: return data && data.state ? data.state.manual_mode === true : false;

settings.title: MANUAL FAN RPM
settings.parseValueFunction: return data && data.state && data.state.fan_rpm_latest !== undefined ? Number(data.state.fan_rpm_latest) : 800;

dataToValue.dataToValueFunction: return data !== undefined && data !== null ? Math.round(Number(data)) : 800;
